The '''Cultural District''' was a district of [[Livien Magnus]] located on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. It was very upscale, so mostly rich [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] visited the businesses in the Cultural District.<ref name="OAA" />
